name: Early Stage Diabetes Risk Prediction: Bangladesh Clinical Survey Benchmark
description: The Early Stage Diabetes Risk Prediction dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository (ID 529) is a symptom-based clinical survey benchmark compiled at the Sylhet Diabetes Hospital in Sylhet, Bangladesh. Published in Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine, the dataset contains 520 direct patient records (320 diabetic patients and 200 non-diabetic controls) characterized by age, gender, and 14 clinical diagnostic symptoms: polyuria, polydipsia, sudden weight loss, weakness, polyphagia, genital thrush, visual blurring, itching, irritability, delayed healing, partial paresis, muscle stiffness, alopecia, and obesity. The benchmark enables low-cost non-invasive screening models for early diabetes detection in developing healthcare settings.
